title: Cell-specific transcription dysregulation in human Huntington's disease-positive developing striatum
title_zh: 人类亨廷顿病阳性发育期纹状体细胞特异性转录失调
abstract: Abstract Huntington’s disease (HD) is a neurodegenerative disorder caused by a CAG-repeat expansion in the HTT gene. Progressive loss of striatal projection neurons leads to cognitive, psychiatric, and motor impairments that typically manifest in midlife, despite the expansion being present from conception. Increasing evidence supports a neurodevelopmental component to HD; however, authentic human developing HD-positive striatal tissue has not previously been characterised. We used single-cell RNA sequencing to compare an HD-positive human fetal striatal sample to an age- and sex-matched control, with CAG-repeat lengths of 16, 49 and 16, 17 respectively. We also compared the fetal HD-positive transcriptional signature with publicly available datasets from postmortem adult HD-positive brain tissue. We identified 2,032 differentially expressed genes and defined nine cellular clusters.. Gene enrichment analysis revealed alteration of key biological processes across the developing HD-positive striatum, with pathway-level dysregulation varying between clusters. There was substantial overlap in gene expression changes between fetal and adult HD-positive striatal tissues, although not in all transcriptional profiles, and some were reversed. Together, these findings demonstrate that molecular features of HD pathology are present during early human striatal development, supporting the concept that disease mechanisms are established decades prior to clinical onset.
abstract_zh: 摘要亨廷顿病（HD）是由HTT基因中的CAG重复扩张引起的神经退行性疾病。纹状体投射神经的进行性丧失导致中年出现认知、精神和运动障碍，尽管该扩张自受孕起即存在。越来越多的证据支持HD的神经发育成分；然而，此前从未对真实的、亨廷顿病阳性的人类发育期纹状体组织进行过表征。我们使用单细胞RNA测序比较了一个亨廷顿病阳性的人类胚状体样本和一个按年龄和性别匹配的对照样本，CAG重复长度分别为16、49和16、17。我们还将胚状体亨廷顿病阳性转录特征与公开的术后成年亨廷顿病阳性脑组织数据集进行了比较。我们鉴定出2,032个差异表达基因并定义了九个细胞群。基因富集分析显示，在发育期亨廷顿病阳性纹状体中，关键生物过程的改变在不同细胞群间有所差异。胚状体和成年亨廷顿病阳性纹状体组织之间的基因表达变化存在显著重叠，尽管并非在所有转录轮廓中，且有一些被逆转。综上所述，这些发现表明亨廷顿病病理的分子特征在早期人类纹状体发育中已存在，支持疾病机制在临床发病前数十年就已确立的概念。
